title: ConvertTo-Json default depth (2) silently truncates nested objects
symptoms: Nested config objects written as literal "@{...}" strings in the output JSON
explanation: ConvertTo-Json's default -Depth is 2 (still, in PS7). Deeper structures are silently stringified to "@{...}" instead of serialized. Always pass explicit -Depth when writing nested config (e.g. SimpleModelServer.config.json).
